items.question: When a verification scenario needs a harness run in a rebuilt, restarted session, defer it as pending in verification-evidence.md, or block the PR until a restarted session runs it?
options: Defer the live half as pending evidence
Block the PR until a restarted session runs them
items.why: D11: agent-rules requires the evidence-file route; the previous spec used it.

items.question: After a graph refresh that exits 0, do workers treat the graph as current at HEAD, even when graphify left the file (and its built-at commit) unchanged?
options: Trust the exit code: current at HEAD, 0 behind
Keep counting from the file's built-at commit
Force a graph write on every refresh
items.why: D1: graphify 0.9.35 leaves an unchanged graph untouched, so the count would show a fresh graph as stale forever.

items.header: What counts as a graph call
items.question: In the harness usage graph column, what counts as one graph call?
options: One Bash row naming explain, query or path
Each graphify invocation inside a row
items.why: D4: summaries are cut at 160 characters, and a row naming a graphify-out path is a raw read.

items.question: When graphify update fails or times out, does the run write a ledger note and continue, or stop the phase?
items.why: D6: the graph is an index; a stale graph only turns citations into hints.

items.question: What is the posture on refunds and forfeiture, credits, personal data and erasure, and the legal/compliance framing?
options: n/a — the spec touches no money, personal data, or legal surface
items.why: D13: the spec changes only harness briefs, launch lines and a usage column.
